Definition: unction (the act); by implication, a consecratory gift
BiblicalUsage: The word is the anointing, the oil and the act, and it runs through the whole setting apart of the tabernacle. Moses poured the anointing oil on Aaron's head, the oil itself was compounded as a holy anointing oil, and the tabernacle and all its vessels were anointed with it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the anointing is the mark of being set apart. Oil on the head means God has chosen this man and this place for His own, and the same Spirit anoints His people still.
